root_cause.text: Integer overflow in ubuf size calculation within `amdxdna_get_ubuf()` when adding `va_ent[i].len` to `exp_info.size`, leading to an undersized allocation and potential memory corruption.
root_cause.evidence: The patch uses `check_add_overflow()` to validate the addition `exp_info.size += va_ent[i].len` before allocation, and the CVE description states that the overflow results in an undersized allocation and possible memory corruption.
